tools.name: botsharper_releve
tools.description: Wallet report: where a public Solana address ranks among the pump.fun operators measured by BotSharper: percentile, quintile, number of closed positions, share of winning positions, average multiple, share of total losses, with the benchmarks of its quintile. Past facts only: no forecast, no advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "botsharper_releve" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Relevé de position d'une adresse Solana publique parmi les opérateurs pump.fun mesurés par BotSharper : centile, quintile, nombre de positions soldées, taux de positions gagnantes, multiple moyen, part de pertes totales, avec les repères du quintile. Constat sur le passé uniquement : ne prédit rien " → after: "Wallet report: where a public Solana address ranks among the pump.fun operators measured by BotSharper: percentile, quintile, number of closed positions, share of winning positions, average multiple, share of total losses, with the benchmarks of its quintile. Past facts only: no forecast, no advice."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
